mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market health and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 10% of 12-month moving averages indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal fails to predict negative returns in >30% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.01 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive monthly employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates robust labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in <55% of instances with PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <45% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.01 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) below 5-year moving averages indicate economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction signal fails to predict negative returns in >35% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.01 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market (HOUST > 1400) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS > 470000) signals elevated consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <55% of instances when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 470000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
